plan_notes: LIBRARIAN: lead with outlet RSS / sitemap_news.xml feeds for recency (WebSearch site: queries return stale evergreen pages) - e.g. theverge.com/rss/index.xml, engadget.com/rss.xml, arstechnica.com/gadgets/feed/, androidauthority.com/feed/, 9to5google.com/feed/, 9to5mac.com/feed/, macrumors.com/macrumors.xml, xda-developers.com/feed/, tomsguide.com/feeds.xml, techradar.com/feeds.xml, uploadvr.com/rss/, roadtovr.com/feed/, notebookcheck.net RSS, cnet/zdnet sitemaps. Filter feed items against the working keywords + expansions above, then use WebSearch ONLY to fill gaps for keywords the feeds did not hit. Recency window: 14 days (published on/after 2026-10-01); verify each item's published time on the page. AI must be what makes the story (drop plain spec/price news without an AI feature). Skip the deprioritized_recently_covered stories unless there is a genuinely new fact (launch, ship date, new feature). Diversify across device classes (robots, PCs/chips, TV, XR, wearables, phones, home) rather than stacking one vendor; check cross-section duplicates (design/games may carry the same XR or glasses story).
